Make up a market with one brand and two competitors, and let two demo assistants answer once a week for four weeks. The answers come from the built-in mock engine, and nothing is sent anywhere. The demo prints the same summary and trend you get from a real run. Pass --keep DIR to save the project and its history, so you can try the other commands on them.

Related commands:
  llmention quick
  llmention init

Output:
  Shows text you can read in your terminal.
  Use --json to get JSON for scripts and other programs.

Usage:
  llmention demo [flags]

Examples:
llmention demo
llmention demo --keep ./llmention-demo
llmention demo --json

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for demo
      --keep string   Save the demo project and its history in this folder

Global Flags:
      --config string   Path to the config file
      --dry-run         Preview changes without performing them
      --json            Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi         Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color        Disable color in human output
      --no-pager        Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt       Never block on an interactive prompt
      --quiet           Suppress non-essential output
